description: This file contains mock callback functions for the OcdmSessions, used in testing the handling of CDM session events such as challenge processing, key updates, error messages, and key updates notifications.

classes.name: OcdmSessionsCallbacksMock
classes.description: A mock class providing singleton access to callback handling methods for CDM session events.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of OcdmSessionsCallbacksMock.

methods.name: processChallengeCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked to process a challenge, forwarding the call to the mock instance.

methods.name: keyUpdateCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a key update occurs, forwarding the call to the mock instance.

methods.name: errorMessageCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked to handle an error message, forwarding the call to the mock instance.

methods.name: keysUpdatedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when keys are updated, forwarding the call to the mock instance.
